"JUMBO BUCKS" has gone close to two months without a top prize claim, and tickets kept selling. Only a fixed number of tickets are printed. About a third of the tickets are sold, and every remaining $2 million prize is still unclaimed. That leaves the same top prizes among fewer tickets.

If "JUMBO BUCKS" is your usual pick, check this page often. The prize counts change even when the ticket looks the same.
1639.headline: No new top prize claims

1640.body:
A $5 million top prize on "MEGA BUCKS" was claimed two weeks ago. The game started with four top prizes and has two top prizes left. The prize table has today's count for every prize level.

Today's free summary of "MEGA BUCKS" ends here. Every number behind it is on this page.
1640.headline: A top prize was just claimed

1641.body:
Of all the tickets printed for "POWER 20X", about half are still unsold. The game is near the midpoint of its run, with two of four top prizes unclaimed. In every scratcher, either the tickets or the prizes run out first. The rest of this page shows the details.

Everything above about "POWER 20X" comes from the Florida Lottery's own published numbers. We only do the counting.
1641.headline: Where this game is in its run

Everything here about "$500,000 CASH BLITZ" comes from official Florida lottery numbers, current through October 11.

Every line of WILD 9S's prize table below shows today's count, not last month's.
1643.headline: The top prize list got shorter

1644.body:
"MONEY ROLL" has six of six top prizes left and is near the start of its run. About a quarter of the tickets are already sold. As a game goes on, the same prizes are spread across fewer tickets. Right now, the top prizes are being claimed more slowly than the tickets are selling, which is a good sign.

The numbers for "MONEY ROLL" are recalculated every morning, and this page changes with them.

1645.headline: Fewer $1 million prizes left

1646.body:
Of the unclaimed prize money on "$2,000,000 SPECTACULAR", about three-quarters is in wins under $1,000. The game is a game built around small prizes that are won often. That is neither good nor bad, only how it was designed. Choose the kind of game that fits the win you want.

Today's free summary of "$2,000,000 SPECTACULAR" ends here. Every number behind it is on this page.
1646.headline: Same price, different prizes

1647.body:
$15,000,000 PLATINUM PAYOUT's prizes make it a game built around small prizes that are won often. Of the prize money still unclaimed, most is in wins under $5,000. The prize counts change every day, but this design does not.

How far "$15,000,000 PLATINUM PAYOUT" is through its run does not decide anything by itself. It changes how closely to look at the other numbers.

Tomorrow's count on "$15,000,000 PLATINUM PAYOUT" will be a little different. The game sells every day, and this page keeps track.

Each day without a top prize claim on "FLORIDA 300X THE CASH", the remaining top prizes are spread across fewer unsold tickets. The number of tickets printed is fixed.
